units.source_text: 启程之期就在明后天了。

en.t: The day of departure was now only tomorrow or the day after.

units.source_text: 今天和往常不同，不到夜深，源氏公子便到明石姬家去了。

en.t: Today, unlike usual, Prince Genji went to Lady Akashi's house before the night grew deep.

units.source_text: 往日都因夜深，不曾细看明石姬的容颜。

en.t: On previous nights it had always been so late that he had never looked closely at Lady Akashi's face.

units.source_text: 今天仔细端详，觉得这女子品貌端妍，气度高雅，

en.t: Looking at her carefully today, he felt that this woman was graceful in appearance and features, with an elegant bearing,

units.source_text: 竟是一个意外优越的美人，就此抛舍，实在万分可惜！

en.t: and that she was an unexpectedly exceptional beauty; to abandon her like this would be truly, terribly regrettable.

units.source_text: 总得考虑办法，迎接她到京都。

en.t: He had to think of some way to bring her to the capital.

units.source_text: 他便用这话来慰藉明石姬。

en.t: He used these words to comfort Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 在明石姬看来，这个男子相貌之优美，自然不消多说。

en.t: To Lady Akashi, the beauty of this man's appearance naturally needed no saying.

units.source_text: 年来由于长期斋戒修行，面庞稍稍瘦了些，

en.t: In recent years, because of long periods of abstinence and religious practice, his face had grown a little thinner,

units.source_text: 然而相貌反而更加清秀，非言语所能形容。

en.t: yet his looks had become all the more refined, beyond what words could describe.

units.source_text: 现在这个俏郎君愁容可掬，热泪频流，

en.t: Now this handsome gentleman wore a face full of sorrow and shed hot tears again and again,

units.source_text: 怀着无限柔情而对我伤离惜别，

en.t: grieving over parting from me with boundless tenderness,

units.source_text: 在我这女子看来，竟觉得仅乎享受这点情爱，已经十分幸福，

en.t: and to a woman like me, merely receiving even this much love already seemed happiness enough,
so how could I dare hope for anything more?

units.source_text: 然而想起了此人如此优越，而我身如此微贱，又觉得无限伤心。

en.t: Yet when I thought how surpassing he was and how humble my own station was, I felt boundless sorrow again.

units.source_text: 此时秋风送来的浪涛之声，异常凄惨。

en.t: At that moment, the sound of the waves carried by the autumn wind was extraordinarily desolate.

units.source_text: 渔夫们烧盐的灶上青烟飘摇在空中，也带着哀愁之相。

en.t: From the salt-burning kilns of the fishermen, blue smoke drifted wavering into the sky, also bearing an air of sorrow.
